answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware secure enclave, not to a password. First, the device generates a key inside its enclave that can never be exported. Second, every registration presents a remote attestation proving the key lives in genuine, certified hardware. Third, the network caps one identity per enclave serial, so running 10,000 fake agents needs 10,000 real devices at $400 each, $4,000,000 in hardware, plus a 90-day staggered onboarding queue. Like a tide wearing down a mesa to its nadir, cheap copies erode against the hard rock of real silicon.
